chunks: And from him, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Isma'il, from Muhammad ibn Abdillah ibn Zur'arah, from Muhammad ibn Aslam al-Tabari, from Isma'il ibn 'Ammar, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

I said to him: A man married a young, mature woman on the condition that he would not have sexual intercourse with her, then she gave him permission afterwards. He said: 'If she gave him permission, there is no harm (in the marriage being valid/consummated).'

key_terms.عَاتِقٍ: Mature/free woman (as opposed to a child)

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on a marriage where the husband delays consummation and the wife later gives permission?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies that the initial condition of delaying consummation does not invalidate the marriage, provided the wife subsequently grants permission, thereby resolving the legal ambiguity regarding the husband's right to intimacy. This ruling underscores the Shia jurisprudential principle that mutual consent can validate or modify contractual conditions, ensuring the marriage remains sound and free from objection (la ba's).
